extraction_notes: Extracted catalytic-performance data from SI Figures S5, S6a,b, S7 and S16. SI Figure S6c was skipped as an Arrhenius/activation-energy plot. SI Figure S8 was skipped as a literature-comparison plot. Other SI figures shown are characterization, DFT/modelled data, or non-catalytic performance. All values are approximate readings from plotted markers/bars; all figure-derived performance values use qualifier '~'. In SI Figure S16 the caption gives no reaction conditions; conditions were associated with the matching 260 °C, 3.2 MPa, H2/CO2 = 3, GHSV = 8000 mL·g^-1·h^-1 performance set where indicated in notes.
